features.name: Translatable Excel Layouts
features.description: Ability to create Excel report layouts that support multiple languages using translation tags and dynamic language substitution at runtime based on user language settings.
caveats: Primarily designed for ISVs and multi-country operations

features.name: Report Metadata Worksheet
features.description: A hidden worksheet automatically added to Excel layouts containing static and runtime metadata including report object information, request properties, tenant ID, environment name, company name and ID, and timestamp of when the report was run.
caveats: Available as hidden worksheet in Excel reports

features.name: Caption Data Worksheet
features.description: Worksheet that stores all captions from report columns and labels from the report object label section, populated with values at runtime when users run the report.

features.name: Runtime Translation Using Translation Tags
features.description: Ability to use dollar-dollar translation tags in worksheet names, chart headers, pivot elements, and slicer headers that are replaced with user-language values at runtime when the report is executed.

features.name: User-Defined Translation Data Worksheet
features.description: Worksheet that allows report layout designers to add custom text strings and translations in multiple languages directly to the layout when these strings are not available as captions in the report object.
caveats: Optional, only needed if custom strings are required

features.name: Refreshable Excel Reports via Power Query and APIs
features.description: Ability to load data into Excel reports using Power Query connected to Business Central APIs instead of the report data set, enabling refreshable reports by retrieving environment name and company ID from the report metadata worksheet.
caveats: Users must enable content in Excel due to Power Query security requirements

features.name: New Excel Reports in Base Application
features.description: Seven new Excel preview reports shipped in version 24 with the base application, added to Business Manager and Accountant role centers as examples of translatable reports and Power Query integration patterns.
caveats: Still in preview - design may be tweaked based on user feedback

features.name: Aged Accounts Receivables Excel Report
features.description: One of seven new preview Excel reports in version 24, demonstrating translatable layout techniques, Power Query integration, filtering by customer dimensions and periods, and multi-currency support.
caveats: Some translation strings still need adjustment

features.name: Multiple Data Items in Separate Worksheets
features.description: Starting in version 23.0, Excel layouts can display each top-level data item from a report in its own worksheet, allowing developers to organize complex data sets more effectively.

features.name: Excel Copilot for Data Analysis
features.description: Excel Copilot enables users to analyze, understand and visualize data through natural language interface, including exploring data, finding outliers, and suggesting analytical insights.
features.status_evidence_quote: this is about Excel co-pilot it's is still in in preview in Excel
caveats: Requires workbook to be on OneDrive

features.name: Open in Excel from List Pages
features.description: Users can open raw data sets directly from any list page in Business Central into Excel for analysis and reporting.

features.name: Excel Layout Raw Data Export
features.description: Reports with Excel layouts provide raw data sets directly in Excel, enabling seamless integration with Business Central for analysis.

features.name: OneDrive Integration for Copilot
features.description: Excel workbooks must be stored on OneDrive for Excel Copilot functionality to work seamlessly with Business Central.
